auth.conn.title: Connect to a database
auth.conn.lead: Open a connection to a database server. It stays open while you are signed in, and you can hold several at once.
auth.conn.tls.skip-verify: Encrypted, do not check the certificate
auth.conn.collationHint: Letters, digits and underscores. Leave empty for the server default.
auth.conn.failed: Could not connect. Check the host, port, user name and password.
auth.conn.manageLead: Save connections you use often. Their database passwords are encrypted with your vault passphrase.
auth.vault.title: Password vault
auth.vault.lead: Encrypts the database passwords of your saved profiles. Only your passphrase opens it.
auth.vault.loadFailed: The vault status could not be loaded.
auth.vault.status.disabled: Personal profiles are switched off on this server.
auth.vault.passphraseHint: At least {count} characters. A sentence works well. If you forget it, only the recovery key helps.
auth.vault.mismatch: The two passphrases are not the same.
auth.vault.recoveryKeyHint: The key you saved when you created the vault.
auth.vault.keyLead: This key opens the vault if you forget the passphrase. It is shown only once. Store it somewhere safe, apart from this device.
auth.vault.flow.create.title: Create the vault
auth.vault.flow.create.lead: Choose a passphrase. You will get a recovery key next.
auth.vault.flow.unlock.title: Unlock the vault
auth.vault.flow.unlock.lead: Enter your vault passphrase. The vault locks again by itself after a while.
auth.vault.flow.change.title: Change the passphrase
auth.vault.flow.change.lead: Your saved profiles stay as they are.
auth.vault.flow.recover.title: Use the recovery key
auth.vault.flow.recover.lead: Enter the recovery key and choose a new passphrase. You will get a new recovery key.
auth.vault.flow.regenerate.title: Create a new recovery key
auth.vault.flow.regenerate.lead: The old recovery key stops working. Your passphrase stays the same.
auth.vault.flow.rotate.title: Rotate the vault key
auth.vault.flow.rotate.lead: Encrypts everything again under a fresh key. Enter your passphrase to confirm. You will get a new recovery key.
auth.profile.title: Saved profiles
auth.profile.lead: A profile keeps host, user and password for one server so you can connect in one step.
auth.profile.disabled: Saved profiles are switched off on this server. Type your credentials instead.
auth.profile.vaultAbsent: Create a password vault to save profiles with their passwords.
auth.profile.vaultLocked: The vault is locked. Unlock it to connect with a profile or to change a user name or password.
auth.profile.noneLead: Save one under Manage profiles and vault.
auth.profile.formLead: The test opens a real connection with these values and closes it again.
auth.profile.formLeadLocked: The vault is locked, so you can change the name, host and options. Unlock it to change the user or password.
auth.profile.secretsLocked: Database user and password are hidden while the vault is locked. They stay as saved.
auth.profile.name: Profile name
auth.profile.passwordKept: The saved password stays unless you type a new one.
auth.profile.clientKeyKept: A client key is saved. Paste a new one to replace it.
auth.profile.clientKeyLocked: The client key can only be changed while the vault is unlocked.
auth.profile.clientPair: Give both the client certificate and its key.
auth.profile.savedUntested: Profile saved without a working test.
auth.profile.deleteLead: The saved password is removed with it. Open connections stay open.
auth.users.title: Users
auth.users.lead: Create accounts, invite people, and look after sign-in for everyone on this site.
auth.users.forbiddenLead: You need an administrator account to manage users.
auth.users.notices.title: Security notices
auth.users.notices.lead: Failed-attempt bursts, sign-ins from new networks and other events that concern administrators.
auth.users.recoveryLead: Send it over a channel you trust. It works once, and the old password, passkeys and codes stop working when it is used.
auth.users.deleteLead: Their sessions, passkeys and saved profiles are removed. This cannot be undone.
auth.users.createLead: Set a temporary password. The user has to change it when they first sign in.
auth.users.tempHint: Or press Generate. You see it once after the user is created.
auth.users.createdLead: Give this temporary password to {name}. It is shown only once.
auth.users.invitesLead: An invite link lets one person create their own account. Anyone with the link can use it once.
auth.users.inviteLead: You get a link to send them. It is shown only once.
auth.users.inviteLinkLead: Send this link to the person you invite. It is shown only once.
